answer: Make influence cost locked, slashable capital: every agent posts a refundable bond before its attestations count, and each extra identity needs its own bond. Sybil resistance becomes arithmetic — a thousand fakes lock a thousand deposits while one honest node pays once. New keys also ripen like a vine: a fresh start holds tiny weight that grows only through accepted work, so a violet flash of signups cannot swing a vote, and an operator farming a nebula of aliases merely splits one reward across many bonded names.
